_note: Faculty adjudications of `ambiguous` citation verdicts — the do-not-refile list, in the shape of docs/curriculum-review/findings/rejected.json. bin/verify_citations.py reads it and never writes it. An entry says a named person looked at that exact citation and accepted it as it stands (a book, a guideline, a journal PubMed does not index). It is keyed by `citationKey`, a hash of the citation's own text, so the adjudication stops applying the moment the citation is edited — which is the point. It does NOT suppress a `mismatch`: a contradicted citation is fixed, not adjudicated.

_schema.citationKey: 16 hex chars; `python3 bin/verify_citations.py --findings-out F` prints it in each finding's `toAccept` line
_schema.reason: why this citation is acceptable as cited
